subject: Clarifying PO split, net30 exception, and invoice cutoffs
messages:
From: Alex Whitmore <alex.whitmore@procureco.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure-finance@procureco.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO formatting & payment terms question for Redwood contract

Hi Markus / Ben,

Quick one from procurement as we're preparing the PO for the Redwood agreement: ProcureCo requires the following on all vendor POs — 1) the company needs to accept split POs (we will issue separate POs per business unit code), 2) invoices must reference the PO number and business unit code, and 3) our standard payment term is Net 30 on receipt.

Two clarifying questions: can Redwood accept multiple PO numbers for a single master contract and issue consolidated monthly invoices grouped by business unit? Also, we have an AP cutoff on the 25th of each month for payments processed in the following cycle — does Redwood support an invoice cutoff so we can align our payment run?

Attaching our internal PO template for reference. If Net 30 is acceptable, we'll proceed with issuing the POs. If you need alternate billing cadence or a single consolidated PO, please let us know what exceptions are available.

Thanks,
Alex Whitmore
Director, Strategic Procurement
ProcureCo Inc.

Attachment: ProcureCo_PO_Template.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Whitmore <alex.whitmore@procureco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting & payment terms question for Redwood contract

Hi Alex — thanks for the clarity and for sending the template. Short answers up front: we can accept multiple PO numbers tied to a single master agreement, and we can include the PO number + business unit code on each invoice. Net 30 is our standard for enterprise customers and is fine.

A few operational notes so accounting can map properly:
- Invoices can be issued monthly and can include line-level PO references.
- We can split invoices by business unit if you want separate invoices per PO, or we can issue a consolidated monthly invoice that lists each PO number on its own line. Let me know which you prefer (separate PDFs per PO vs single PDF with line items).
- Regarding your AP cutoff (25th): we can implement an invoice cutoff date of the 20th -- invoices generated after the 20th will be included in the following month's billing run. That gives us two business days to close and validate before your 25th run. If you need the cutoff later, we'll need to align on expedited review and a slightly adjusted posting schedule.

I attached our standard PO template and a draft SOW so your legal/finance teams have the fields they usually expect. Ben, looping you for the commercial note on committed spend / discount cadence. Lauren, could you confirm the billing reference we should use so ProcureCo maps payments to the correct Ledger account?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Draft_v2.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Whitmore <alex.whitmore@procureco.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting & payment terms question for Redwood contract

Alex — appreciate the note. A couple of commercial items that may matter to ProcureCo:
- We can offer a 7% discount on list rates if you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity block (minimum annual commitment $250k). That discount applies whether you sign a single PO or multiple POs referencing the same deal id.
- For pay-as-you-go (no commit) customers we don't apply a discount, but we can offer an interim credit (one-off) for onboarding.

If ProcureCo wants to keep separate POs per BU, the discount calculation will still be applied against the total committed spend across the POs so long as they reference the DEAL-2026-481 identifier and the billing contact is consistent.

Also: if you need invoices split per PO for internal chargeback, we can emit separate PDFs and include cross references for easier reconciliation. If you prefer a consolidated invoice we will include a totalling section with per-PO breakdowns. Which is easier for your Finance team?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Whitmore <alex.whitmore@procureco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure-finance@procureco.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting & payment terms question for Redwood contract

Thanks Ben / Markus — this is helpful. Quick responses from procurement & finance:
- ProcureCo will proceed with split POs by BU, but we want separate invoice PDFs per PO for internal chargeback.
- Net 30 is fine. Please set invoice cutoff at the 20th for the first three months while we validate postings; we will revisit for steady-state.
- The Procurement team is open to the 7% committed-capacity discount. We have an internal approval process for commit levels; once the Budget Owner signs off we'll issue a master PO referencing DEAL-2026-481 and then separate issuance per BU.

Next step: can you send a redline-friendly master PO template with the DEAL id populated and instructions on how to populate BU codes on the invoice? Also please include the billing remit details and Redwood tax/VAT IDs.

Alex

Hi Alex — looping in Redwood Finance. A couple of items for your AP team:

1) Remit to (for ACH/wire): Redwood Inference Inc.
   Bank: Palo Alto Community Bank
   Account: xxxxx1234
   Routing: xxxxxxxx

2) Billing contact: invoices@redwoodinference.com (please cc accounts-payable@procureco.com so we can reconcile quickly)

3) Tax/VAT: Redwood US Tax ID: 12-3456789; VAT not applicable for US-based entity. If ProcureCo needs an EU VAT form for their EU subsidiaries, let us know and we will route to the tax team.

4) On the invoice please place the PO number in the Invoice header and include a single-line CSV listing of BU codes next to each line item (we will pick this up into our AP system).

Per the agreed process: Redwood will issue separate PDF invoices per PO, with the DEAL-2026-481 reference in the invoice footer. We'll run a monthly billing cycle with a 20th cutoff for the first three months as requested. After three months we'll review whether to move to a 25th cutoff.

I will send a redline-friendly PO template and a short reconciliation guide to the procurement mailbox this afternoon.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
